channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bill Self | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bill Self from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darryn Peterson on Bill Self
item.description:
Peterson played the two at Kansas, but has long been most comfortable as an on-ball initiator.

“Up until last year I was on the ball pretty much my whole life. At Kansas they put me off the ball and Coach [Bill Self] said it gave our team the best chance to win. I’m a winner and he said that so that’s what I was going to do,”

Darryn Peterson on Bill Self, Jun 23, 2026. Source: monumentalsportsnetwork.com.

item.title: Christian Braun on Bill Self
item.description:
“A big thing that Coach [Bill] Self taught was when you win, the pie is big enough for everybody. I think that my individual success, I always have more individual success when our team wins and the spotlight's bigger when you're winning.”

Christian Braun on Bill Self, Dec 10, 2024. Source: Responsible Gaming.

item.title: Christian Braun on Bill Self, Michael Malone
item.description:
Michael Singer:Christian Braun, on the comparisons between Michael Malone and Bill Self:

“Those are two of the most competitive people I’ve been around since I’ve been playing basketball.”

Christian Braun on Bill Self, Michael Malone, May 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Ramsey Nijem on Bill Self
item.description:
“Ultimately it’s an opportunity to work alongside a Hall of Fame coach in coach (Bill) Self and his staff,”

Ramsey Nijem on Bill Self, Sep 5, 2019. Source: Kansas City Star.
